messages.subject: [Rcicr-users] rcicr version 0.2.4 available on CRAN
messages.body_plain:
Version 0.2.4 of the rcicr package is now available on CRAN. The latest update includes a function to batch generate classification images for multiple participants or conditions. See http://ron.dotsch.org/rcicr for more information.
